decision.thesis: All cash, the twenty-third all-cash row and the second decision of ramp week 5. Wednesday 10-07 is decomposed on the 2026-10-07 feedback page: no book name moved past 1.5 sigma and every one reads not_significant; ^KLSE fell 1.32% to its lowest close since 2025-12-10, led by the banks (CIMB -4.81%, Hong Leong Bank -6.03%, AMMB -4.48%), and the market titles name foreign selling, oil and US yields with no fund-flow print in the store. A leg with no dated cause is not a thesis. Claim: nothing in the fundable universe beats cash over 21 sessions.
